PSA is ready

Playing Speed Adjuster now works on every page with audio or video. Try it here first.

New in this version

    A little tune to try PSA onPress play

    Try it

    1. Press play. A small pill with the speed appears in the corner.
    2. Press ] to go faster, [ to go slower, or \ for 1.5×.
    3. Hover the pill for − and +, or scroll on it.
    4. Click the blue dot to open the full panel.
    Every site remembersSet a speed once and the site keeps it for next time.
    YouTube channelsTurn on "Just this channel" to give one channel a speed of its own.
    The toolbar buttonOpens the panel on any page, or explains why PSA is off there.
    Nothing you do on this page is saved.
